note: Kimball traded his Iowa property for four pianos in 1857 and sold them from a second-storey office; he married Evaline M. Cone in 1865. 'Mr. Kimball died at home after a lingering illness on December 16, 1904. His funeral was held in his home'; 'The honorary pallbearers included: Marshall Field, Robert T. Lincoln, Lambert Tree, Robert H. McCormick, Watson F. Blair, Charles H. Deere and J. J. Glessner. The active pallbearers were all employees of the company.' They had no children; Mrs. Kimball died in 1921 and left her paintings to the Art Institute.
